subject: Kickoff: FinanceHarness analyst-assist pilot
body:
Team — kicking off FinanceHarness productization for graphs-retrieval.

The release gives us a model-agnostic deep-research agent — web research as a search, visit, cite loop, plus an equity slice with fundamentals, comps, and DCF/WACC — with a headless core we can run behind any backbone via the providers config.

Product target: an analyst-assist service for the internal strategy and finance teams, exposed through the HTTP+SSE service rather than the CLI.

Milestones: backbone profiles wired to our internal endpoints by Mar 6; retrieval grounded in our licensed market-data corpus by early April; a skill library (SKILL.md format) for our recurring report types by end of April; a pilot with Idris's org and a launch-review pre-read by May 8.

Halima owns the agent core, Wei evaluation, Leilani serving, Paloma skills. Ivo follows up on resourcing.

Anders
